caption: Light from the microdisplay is magnified by the lens into a virtual image at 20 cm in this teaching case; the eye focuses on that image. A combiner adds a see-through path from the real world to the same eye.

spec.aria: Two light paths: a microdisplay 4 cm behind a lens of focal length 5 cm forms a virtual image 20 cm away and 5 times larger, seen by the eye; a real-world path passes through a combiner to the same eye.
